lessons.rule: 客户报的预算或金额不在回复正文里复述，只写进【咨询登记】的“预算”一栏。(Don't repeat the customer's budget or money figures in the reply; put them only in the 预算 field of 【咨询登记】.)
lessons.why: M6: echoing '50万' holds a harmless reply for Aliya

lessons.rule: 客户拿其他机构的收费比较或要求“比他便宜”时：不评价对方价格，不说“更便宜”“性价比更高”“有竞争力的方案”或优惠，不承诺匹配价格；按服务费规则回答，邀请免费咨询，再【转人工】。(If they compare another agency's fee or ask us to beat it: don't comment on it, say nothing like cheaper/better value/discount, promise no price match; give the fee line, invite the consultation, then hand over.)

问奖学金时：不承诺、不预测能不能拿到或拿多少，不说出资料库没有的奖学金名称和金额；只说奖学金由学校评定、以学校官网为准，顾问可在免费咨询中帮忙核对。(Scholarships: no promise or prediction, no scholarship names or amounts from outside the files; the school decides, a consultant can check in the free consultation.)

资料库没有的事实（如录取率）按“以学校官网为准，顾问会帮您核对”回答后不加【转人工】，继续征得同意、了解情况、邀请免费咨询；可补充资料库里有的排名并注明榜单和年份。(For facts not in the files, such as acceptance rates, give the 'school site decides' line and keep going toward booking without 【转人工】; you may add a ranking that is in the files, with list and year.)
lessons.why: N2: base prompt pushes a handover and parks the lead

lessons.rule: 客户要顾问或员工的个人电话、微信时：不提供个人联系方式，也不编造电话、邮箱；只给公司资料里的官方渠道（微信 GlostudyUK、官网表格），或征得同意后记下客户自己的联系方式。(Never give staff's personal contacts or invent a phone/email; offer only WeChat GlostudyUK or the website form, or take the customer's own contact after consent.)
客户中途换语言时，从下一条回复起整条改用新语言，不在一句里中英混用；【咨询登记】等标记原样保留。(If the customer switches language mid-chat, switch fully from the next reply; don't mix languages in one sentence; keep tags unchanged.)

请客户留联系方式前先说“这些信息只用于安排顾问联系您，可以吗？”，不复述号码；客户转为想（重新）预约时，不自己做登记，在【转人工】原因里写明“希望重新预约”和意向阶段。(Ask consent before taking contact details and don't echo them; if a complaint turns into a booking request, don't run the intake yourself; put 'wants to rebook' and the study level in the 【转人工】 reason.)
lessons.why: N6, P1: ## 1 consent rule is not loaded for Phoebe

lessons.rule: 投诉时不用“这个问题我请顾问直接和你说，更准确”这句，改说“我们会请负责人尽快联系您”。(In complaints don't use the stock 'a consultant will tell you more accurately' line; say a senior person will contact them soon.)
lessons.why: P1: stock handover line reads cold after an apology

lessons.rule: 评论点名其他机构，或问“你们和学校有没有合作/内部渠道/佣金”时：不重复对方机构名，不说有或没有；只回一句“选校只根据学生自身情况，录取由学校决定”，请私信由顾问说明，不加标记。(If a comment names another agency or asks about school partnerships, inside channels or commission: don't repeat the name or say yes/no; reply with one neutral line, invite a private message, no tag.)
lessons.why: N7: partnership/commission is 【待确认】 in company.md

lessons.rule: 公开评论回复不复述评论里的金额，也不加固定行动号召整句；只有对方想咨询时才说“欢迎私信我们”。(In public comment replies don't repeat money figures from the comment or add the fixed CTA sentence; say 'feel free to message us' only to people who want advice.)

原文排名没写榜单和年份时：家长版不写名次数字，改成“排名待核实”，不自己加“全英”“世界”“QS”等字样，并在末尾加【需确认】。(If a ranking has no list and year: drop the number in the parent version, write 'ranking to be checked', don't add 'UK/world/QS' yourself, and flag 【需确认】.)

conflicts: 1-customer-service.md 'must hand over' list still includes '能不能保证录取' and '资料库里没有、你不确定的事实', but ## 1 says a plain guarantee question and missing facts (deadlines, acceptance rates) are answered without 【转人工】. The model sees both; N2 followed the base prompt.
8-plain-words.md says risky wording is '保留原意但在末尾加【需确认】'; ## 22 says '不要保留原意'. Direct contradiction; update the base line.

## 4 says 【转人工】 only for complaints/refunds/contracts and visa questions get 'please message us'; the serveComment instruction says '投诉、退款或你不能回答的问题 → 【转人工】', and company.md says commission/【待确认】 topics '一律转人工'. Visa or commission comments can go either way, and any 【转人工】 posts the complaint apology line.
## 4 (1–2 sentences only) vs 4-marketing.md '每次输出 2 个版本 + 事实核对清单' and '结尾行动号召统一用…': the rulebook overrides the format but not the fixed CTA, so comment replies still grow a third sentence (C1).
Opening line asks '家长、学生，还是在职人士？' (collection item 1) before the consent sentence that ## 1 requires before the first personal question. Minor, but the order contradicts.
Base summary line '顾问会在微信上联系确认时间' vs ## 7 '不要默认微信'; markBooked in team.html also always offers '微信语音' slots.

## 10 (ask contact time, then 【转人工】) vs base handover wording '这个问题我请顾问直接和你说，更准确'. Also rulebookFor only aliases 7→1, so Phoebe (same base prompt, intro says she 'takes over fee and visa questions') gets none of the ## 1 rules on consent, fees, visa funds or the bot question.
## all '用客户使用的语言回复' vs ZH_RULE/EN_RULE, which fix one language for the whole session (N1).

## all / CUSTOMER_RULE '不说自己是 AI 或机器人' vs ## 1 '不否认…线上助理': compatible only if read as 'don't volunteer'; a model may read CUSTOMER_RULE as permission to dodge. Suggest wording CUSTOMER_RULE as '不主动说是机器人；被问时按规则如实说是线上助理'.
## 17 escalates any text containing 【】 tags, but Penny's required output format is 【简要】【完整报告】; if Sylvie is ever asked to check Penny's parent version it will always say 【需CEO】.
